```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- set_prolog_flag(double_quotes, atom).

main :-
    read_line_to_string(user_input, Line),
    ( Line == end_of_file -> true
    ; normalize_space(string(Ns), Line),
      atom_number(Ns, N),
      ( N < 1 -> true
      ; length(Col, N), maplist(=(0), Col),
        M is 2*N-1, length(D1, M), maplist(=(0), D1),
        length(D2, M), maplist(=(0), D2),
        solve(0, N, Col, D1, D2, Ans),
        format("~d~n", [Ans])
      )
    ).

solve(N, N, _, _, _, 1) :- !.
solve(R, N, Col, D1, D2, Count) :-
    R < N,
    findall(1,
        ( between(0, N1, C), N1 is N-1,
          nth0(C, Col, 0),
          I is R+C, nth0(I, D1, 0),
          J is R-C+N-1, nth0(J, D2, 0)
        ), Sols),
    count_solutions(Sols, Col, D1, D2, R, N, Count).

count_solutions([], _, _, _, _, _, 0).
count_solutions([C|Cs], Col, D1, D2, R, N, Total) :-
    I is R+C, J is R-C+N-1,
    set_flag(Col, C, 1, Col1),
    set_flag(D1, I, 1, D1a),
    set_flag(D2, J, 1, D2a),
    solve(R+1, N, Col1, D1a, D2a, Sub),
    count_solutions(Cs, Col, D1, D2, R, N, Rest),
    Total is Sub + Rest.

set_flag(List, Index, Value, NewList) :-
    nth0(Index, List, _, Rest),
    nth0(Index, NewList, Value, Rest).
```
